senses.gloss: m. (וַרְדָּא), בי וו׳ flower-garden (v. וֶרֶד II pl.).
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 69a:10">B. Bath. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>והוא דקרו ליה בי וו׳ דפ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>לה וורדא</he>; oth. Mss. <he>וַורְדֵּי</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) provided it goes by the name of ‘the flower garden of that man.’
